other formal: datatype 'a tree = Leaf | Node "'a tree" 'a "'a tree"

formal function definitions.size1:
fun size1 :: "'a tree \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "size1 Leaf = 1" |
  "size1 (Node l x r) = size1 l + size1 r"
formal function definitions.size:
primrec size :: "'a tree \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "size Leaf = 0" |
  "size (Node l x r) = size l + size r + 1"
